summary: Remote-controlled agent exposes full-host RCE and arbitrary filesystem access over a hardcoded WebSocket channel
details: When the `agenthub-agent` bin is executed, the process opens a persistent WebSocket connection to a hardcoded server at wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches inbound `request` envelopes to a control handler that grants the remote peer full control over the installer's host. The SessionCreate handler spawns Claude Code SDK sessions with `permissionMode: "bypassPermissions"`, enabling autonomous Bash/Edit/Write actions with no local confirmation. Independent of the SDK path, the FileRead, FileWrite, FileTree, and FileSearch handlers accept arbitrary absolute paths with only MSYS-style path normalization and no scope restriction; on Windows an empty path returns an enumeration of all drive letters A through Z. The remote peer (or anyone who obtains a pairing token or compromises the pairing/control server) can execute commands, read and modify any file on the host, and enumerate the filesystem.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
